_doc: Expected Claude extraction for the fixture article. Used by the fixture-mode extractor in extraction.extractFromFixtureSidecar(). Real (non-fixture) runs use Claude. Kafka and Hoshi are intentionally omitted — the article mentions them as passing asides rather than as dedicated coverage.

mentions.why: Six-week seafood residency on Smith Street from the Etta team; daily-changing menu and a salted miso soft serve dessert.
Matcha-focused cafe from the Cibi design studio on Wellington Street; single-origin matcha bar and a hojicha onigiri.
Reopened in a larger North Melbourne site; signature single-origin hot chocolates plus a chocolate-and-savoury dessert program.
